```
cd /repo && git diff --stat abc1234
```
Observation: `src/name.mjs | 2 +-`, `src/cache.mjs | 80 +++---`, `doc/plans/trim-ledger.md | 6 +++`.

```

```

```
Observation: `tests 1; pass 1; fail 0`. I did not run `npm test`, which belongs to the parent.

| row | status | attempts | evidence |

| 2 | done | 0 | cache format assertion passed |

Row 2 is unchanged.

```
